newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet tumbles with gas oil futures in slow mkt.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet tumbles with gas oil futures in slow mkt.

text.p: European jet fuel was nearly $5 a tonne weaker on Friday, pulled lower by sharply lower futures amid a physical market looking distinctly long.
May IPE gas oil was $4.75 a tonne lower at $166.25 a tonne around 1515 GMT.
A trader said a barge was sold at May IPE +$19.50 fob on Friday and commented.
"That seems like a rather strong number given the market is long and not particuarly active,"
Cargo offers of May IPE +$22 cif NWE were not being matched by bids.
"We are looking for +$22 and not getting much interest and we are not likely to sell below," said one seller.
The Mediterranean was equally slow with EU grades hovering around fob high quotes +$6-8 while Libyan was up to $3 below this level.
